verified_facts.text: Grand Hyatt Barcelona is in the Pedralbes district of Barcelona.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Barcelona sits at the heart of Pedralbes

verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from Spotify Camp Nou, home of FC Barcelona.
verified_facts.excerpt: Football fans will find themselves just steps from Spotify Camp Nou, home of FC Barcelona

verified_facts.text: The Monastery of Pedralbes, the Real Club de Tennis Barcelona and Les Corts Market are just steps from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just steps from the hotel, the Monastery of Pedralbes, the Real Club de Tennis Barcelona and the local stalls of Les Corts Market reveal a quieter, residential side of the city

verified_facts.text: Each room has custom-made furniture, a separate rain shower and WC, and Natura Bisse bathroom amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Custom-made furniture, a separate rain shower and WC and Natura Bissé bathroom amenities complete each room

verified_facts.text: Suites have Art Deco-inspired design and are set on the hotel's higher floors with views of Barcelona.
verified_facts.excerpt: with Art Deco-inspired design, many featuring a walk-in closet and exclusive access to Grand Club. From the Junior Suite to the Iconic Suite, Grand Suite and Penthouse, each is set on the hotel's higher floors

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse Suite is a three-bedroom apartment with a show kitchen, a dining area for up to ten and views of the city, sea and mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: This three-bedroom apartment includes a master bedroom, a living room with a separate show kitchen and a dining area for up to ten, with sweeping views of the city, sea and surrounding mountains.

verified_facts.text: The Junior Suite bathroom is finished in custom tilework and marble, with a deep-soaking bathtub and a walk-in shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: a bathroom finished in custom tilework and marble, with dual sinks, a striking deep-soaking bathtub and a walk-in shower. Includes exclusive access to Grand Club Lounge.

verified_facts.text: The Premium King Room with View has direct views of the city and the sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: This room offers direct views of the city and the sea

verified_facts.text: The Grand Club Lounge on the 18th floor serves an American breakfast buffet, snacks during the day and a tapas time in the evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: From a delicious American Breakfast Buffet to Snacks during the day and a dedicated Tapas Time in the evening

verified_facts.text: The Grand Club Lounge is on the 18th floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Grand Club Lounge is located on the 18th Floor

verified_facts.text: Oasis Wellness and Spa by Natura Bisse has a thermal water circuit, sauna, steam bath, and salt and ice cabins.
verified_facts.excerpt: Oasis Wellness & Spa by Natura Bissé is a Mediterranean sanctuary of contrasts with a thermal water circuit, sauna, steam bath, salt and ice cabins

verified_facts.text: The spa has six private cabins for Natura Bisse treatments, including a double suite with a private sauna, steam room and jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: six private cabins for exclusive Natura Bissé treatments (including a double suite with a private sauna, steam room, and jacuzzi)

verified_facts.text: The outdoor pool is set in a garden and is open from spring through autumn.
verified_facts.excerpt: The outdoor pool at Grand Hyatt Barcelona unfolds within a lush, immersive garden setting, made for long, memorable afternoons with friends and family from spring through autumn.

verified_facts.text: Maymanta is a Peruvian restaurant on the 19th-floor rooftop, curated by chef Omar Malpartida.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched on the 19th-floor rooftop, Maymanta Barcelona brings the bold, authentic flavors of Peru to life with a modern twist, curated by chef Omar Malpartida

verified_facts.text: Leña is the first Dani Garcia restaurant in Barcelona, cooking over embers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The first and only Dani García restaurant in Barcelona, Leña reimagines the brasa experience with global flair. Here, exceptional ingredients meet the primal art of cooking over embers

verified_facts.text: Complimentary children's and baby kits are available on request, including colouring sets, booster seats and cribs.
verified_facts.excerpt: baby kits available upon request, including colouring sets, booster seats, cribs, bathtubs, and tailored in-room amenities

verified_facts.text: The King with Extra Bed room pairs a king bed with an additional single bed for families or friends sharing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Built for families or friends sharing a room, this space pairs a king bed with an additional European single bed

verified_facts.text: Dogs are welcomed with an amenity kit including a pet bed, food and water bowls and treats.
verified_facts.excerpt: Dogs are warmly welcomed with a curated amenity kit featuring a plush pet bed, food and water bowls, and gourmet treats

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 6 minutes from the Maria Cristina metro stop on line L3.
verified_facts.excerpt: 6 minutes from the subway stop María Cristina of L3 (green line)

verified_facts.text: Central Barcelona is about a 15-minute metro ride from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: just a 15-minute metro ride from central Barcelona

verified_facts.text: Rooms on lower floors are businesslike, with a gray and white palette and restricted views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lower floors are distinctly businesslike with their muted, gray and white color palette and restricted views.

verified_facts.text: From the 12th floor up, rooms have panoramas of Barcelona stretching down to the Mediterranean.
verified_facts.excerpt: with the 12th floor and up offering eye-popping panoramas of Barcelona stretching all the way down to the Mediterranean

verified_facts.text: The hotel is next to the Catalan Congress Center and the university, and attracts groups and business travelers.
verified_facts.excerpt: setting next to the Catalan Congress Center and university attract groups and business execs

verified_facts.text: There are fewer tourist sites in the area than downtown.
verified_facts.excerpt: While you’ll find fewer tourist sites around here

verified_facts.text: Casa Batllo, Casa Mila and the Sagrada Familia are reachable from the hotel as a base for exploring the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Barcelona sits close to iconic landmarks including Casa Batlló, Casa Milà (La Pedrera) and the Basilica of the Sagrada Familia
